scope: Linux/WSL, single durable control plane, Cursor-first; isolated recovery faults

combined.environment: Real isolated SQLite and separate controller/Worker objects; fake adapter; injected transport outage after durable chunk commit

requirements.K01-2-A01: Persisted accepted Run, Attempt, Session and upload receipt survive controller/Worker reconstruction; process crash retains committed spool.
requirements.K01-2-A02: Lost claim/chunk/report acknowledgements reuse identity and committed receipt; observation timeout does not relaunch.
requirements.K01-2-A03: Recovery, revocation and server-controlled retry preserve original work and failure evidence; failed attempts retained.
requirements.K01-2-A04: Spool ordering and delivery tokens serialize replay; old ownership cannot overwrite final state. Protocol cancellation evidence retained in protocol-recovery-closure.
requirements.K01-2-A05: Duplicate trigger/claim and ACP EOF verified; prior durable schedule and rate/quota recovery evidence reused. Concurrent arbitration and machine restart combinations remain K01-2.02/.03.
requirements.K01-2-A06: Observation timeout never stops/relaunches; complete UTF-8 output restored; incomplete and revoked results rejected; drain allows active completion.

reuse_basis: No runtime implementation changed in this delivery; focused current transport, retry, spool and ACP checks supplement prior native/real Cursor and scheduler evidence.
limits: Object/database reopening is not a machine reboot; machine-restart composition remains K01-2.03.
Physical cross-host old-master fencing remains K01-2.04; concurrent E2AG/circuit arbitration remains K01-2.02.
Active ACP prompt continuation is not qualified by retained-output recovery.

deployment.reason: Only qualification tests, evidence and planning changed; existing deployed runtime retained.
